title: OpenAI is acquiring open source Python tool-maker Astral - Ars Technica
summary: OpenAI acquired Astral, the company behind popular Python development tools, to integrate with its Codex team and accelerate work on Codex. OpenAI will continue supporting Astral's open source projects post-acquisition.
sentiment_reason: The acquisition is a positive move for OpenAI as it integrates with its Codex team and continues to support the Python ecosystem, indicating growth and expansion in the AI-powered coding assistants market.
